# Embedded extension-engine polyfills

The extension engine embeds the bundle built from the existing
`pkg/download/engine/polyfill` project. These notices cover its three runtime
packages; manifest.json records the exact npm versions, source tarballs and
integrity values checked against package-lock.json. Original license and
copyright texts are included beside this file. The whatwg-fetch patch remains
in Corresponding Source. Build-only webpack dependencies are not declared to
be runtime components of the application.
